label: Raritan PX3-5190R switched rack PDU (8xC13, 16A/230V)
description: 1U horizontal switched rack PDU for 200-240 V single-phase feeds: 16 A input on an IEC 60309 2P+E plug, 8 IEC C13 outlets with per-receptacle metering and remote switching, 3.7 kVA. A Gigabit (10/100/1000BASE-T) port is the primary management interface and a second, redundant 10/100BASE-T port provides a backup path for the Web/SSH/SNMP/Modbus-TCP stack.
notes: Engineering submittal (rev 20250625) 'Networking': 'Gigabit (10/100/1000 BaseT) Ethernet port; secondary, redundant (10/100 BaseT) Ethernet port. Optional WiFi (802.11a/b/g/n)'. Remote management over HTTP(s), SSH, Telnet, RS-232, SNMP v2/v3, SMTP, JSON-RPC and Modbus over TCP; environmental-sensor ready (temperature, humidity, air flow, differential pressure, water leak, contact closure) via the RJ-12 sensor ports, which are not Ethernet. Cascading: up to 32 PDUs over the dedicated cascade link, which is a Cat5 PDU-to-PDU bus rather than an Ethernet segment, so it is not modelled and the two exposed ports are the primary and redundant NICs only.
